name: GORET Kawaii Dumpling Squishy Stress Toys
shortDescription: A cheerful set of kawaii dumpling squishy toys with smiling faces, bright colors, and cute steamer baskets for desks, gifts, and fidget-friendly moments.
longDescription: These GORET kawaii dumpling squishy toys bring a playful food-themed look to a desk, shelf, study setup, or gift basket. The listing photos show four colorful steamed-bun style squishies in blue, pink, green, and white, each with a sweet smiling face and a mini steamer-style holder. The images highlight a soft, smooth feel, easy-clean surface, and a larger product size compared with smaller squishy toys. They are best treated as cute fidget toys, desk companions, party favors, or small gifts for people who like kawaii food decor. Before publishing or buying, confirm the exact material, size, age guidance, care instructions, and quantity on the current Amazon listing.
